tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Before paying an agent-payable API (x402 or MPP), check whether it is safe: does it answer reliably, do its payment terms match its listing (no switched or burn wallets, no overcharges), and is the address it asks you to pay one the seller has proven is theirs. Returns verdict ok | caution | avoid |

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: For sellers: check whether an x402 endpoint is listed in Coinbase's Bazaar and, if not, why.
